Use of images

Unless otherwise noted, the copyright of all images and illustrations on this site belongs to Ko Arimatsu.

Terms of use

  • Non-commercial use: free to use with proper credit
  • Commercial use: please contact me in advance
  • Prohibited:
    • Misleading processing or modification
    • Redistribution to third parties
    • Use that violates laws or public order and morals

Contact

For permission requests, please get in touch via Contact.
